reasons: Claimed status is 'compliant' and the redline is unchanged with no counterparty comment, which is the expected output for a compliant finding.

Cited text supports the rationale: § 2 creates an evergreen term terminable under § 6 with no auto-renewal, no renewal term length, and no renewal notice window, so there is no renewal trap for the customer; the § 6(a) 15-day any-reason exit is better than the preferred 30-day opt-out.

Deterministic check (notice window = 15 days ≤ 60) corroborates compliance; treating the structure as compliant rather than 'missing' is correct because the absence of an auto-renewal mechanic raises no negotiation issue for us.
Rationale properly notes the uncapped rate-change right in § 3(b) as a pricing point for the fees rule rather than double-flagging it here, consistent with the no-duplicate-flagging instruction.
